title: Pokemon TCG Korean Vileplume Scarlet & Violet 045/165 Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Vileplume card is a must-have for any Pokémon TCG collector! With a beautiful holo finish and a rare stage 2 evolution, this card is sure to impress. The card features the Grass attribute and is a standard size for easy storage.

It comes from the Scarlet & Violet set and has the card number 045/165. The card is in Korean language and was manufactured by Nintendo in Japan. It's perfect for players aged 8 and up, and would make a great addition to any collection. Don't miss out on the chance to own this amazing Vileplume card!
